notes:
What's new:
- Put files in order in every tool that takes several files (Compress, Unlock, OCR, PDF to Excel and more) - drag a file, use the arrows, remove one, or Sort by name.
- Crop: adjust the box - drag a corner or edge to resize it, drag inside to move it, or drag outside to draw a new one.
- Crop: a different crop on each page. Untick "Apply to all pages" and each page gets its own box; pages you don't touch are left as they are. "Copy box" brings over the box from another page.
- Crop: each page thumbnail shows its crop box, so you can check every page at a glance.
- Redact and Excel: Preview & Fix - click a box to select it, then resize it, move it, or remove it with the red X. (In Preview & Fix, clicking a box now selects it instead of deleting it.)
- "Fit page" button in Crop and Redact shows the whole page.
What's fixed:
- Crop opens with the whole page on screen - no more zooming out to reach the bottom.
- A stray click in Crop no longer throws away the box you set.
- Compress and Unlock Restrictions can now remove a single file from the list.
- Security updates to two built-in components.
